structured_output.rationale: All three lines carry OA-22 with claim-level MOA MA04. The 271 for DOS 2026-01-20 returns EB*R naming Novitas Solutions Medicare Part B FFS as primary with MSG "PLAN IS PRIMARY PAYER FOR THIS MEMBER." The 837P filed Garden State as primary (SBR*P / CI). MA04 here signals missing primary adjudication data — Medicare hasn't paid yet because it was never billed. Bill Medicare first, then return to Garden State as secondary.

root_cause.explanation: 271 EB*R names Novitas Solutions Medicare Part B FFS as primary payer for this member on DOS 2026-01-20. Claim was filed to Garden State as primary (SBR*P/CI). OA-22 = wrong COB order; MA04 = primary adjudication data absent.

next_action.detail: Bill Novitas Solutions Medicare Part B (payer ID 1846349352) as primary. Once Medicare adjudicates, rebill Garden State as secondary (SBR*S) carrying Medicare's payment and CAS data in the 2320/2430 loops to satisfy MA04.
